control_P0.definition: Exact frozen Outcome-B conditional-production architecture and selected route. Persistence and ordered-state probabilities unchanged.

challenger_P1.name: Residual magnitude anchor
challenger_P1.logical_connection: Stage 1 showed weak high-end magnitude transfer: the absolute-level learner uses sublinear log source magnitude plus a bounded percentile and converges toward historical level baselines. P1 adds only one learned continuous source anchor.
challenger_P1.baseline_models: Fit the exact P0 D0/D1 production models and frozen state layers inside each legal rolling-origin training fold.
challenger_P1.training_population: Target-active training rows only, using the same horizon-specific production training population as P0.
challenger_P1.baseline_training_prediction: For each active training row, compute the P0 conditional-active forecast under the frozen route and the fold's fitted state probabilities.
challenger_P1.coefficient_rule: Fit one horizon-level coefficient w_raw to y~x with no intercept; freeze w=clip(w_raw,0,1). No grid or threshold search.
challenger_P1.monotonicity: w is constrained to [0,1], so the correction is a convex pull toward source magnitude rather than an elite-only multiplier.
challenger_P1.pooling: One shared w per horizon across all positions, states and career stages.
challenger_P1.seed: No stochastic optimization; sklearn BayesianRidge deterministic for fixed rows.

challenger_P2.name: Relative log-retention target
challenger_P2.logical_connection: Stage 1 showed an absolute-target scale problem under a shifted current source magnitude distribution. P2 models future production relative to source magnitude directly without an arbitrary denominator floor.
challenger_P2.training_population: Target-active rows only, same legal horizon-specific training rows as P0.
challenger_P2.input_features: Exactly the allowed P0 feature set for the routed treatment: D0 cells use D0 features; D1 cells use D1 state-conditioned features including the frozen two-prior signal where covered.
challenger_P2.preprocessing: Reuse exact P0 training-only scalers, one-hot encoding order, nonnegative prior1 log rule and deterministic row order.
challenger_P2.estimator: Same exact BayesianRidge hyperparameters as P0, fit separately by horizon and required routed treatment (D0 or D1).
challenger_P2.state_combination: D1 routed cells predict one transformed conditional point level per positive future state, then combine with the unchanged positive-state probabilities. D0 routed cells predict one conditional-active level.
challenger_P2.pooling: Same shared/partially pooled P0 feature structure; no player-specific coefficient.
challenger_P2.floors_caps: Zero floor only; no cap; log1p makes the transformation prospectively safe at low source production.
challenger_P2.seed: No stochastic optimization; sklearn BayesianRidge deterministic for fixed rows.

primary_metrics: conditional-active MAE and signed bias on target-active rows
unconditional MAE and signed bias on all rows
predicted-vs-realized conditional retention by source percentile/decile
top10, top5 and young-top10 retention calibration

step1_upper_tail.requirement: At both Y2 and Y3, aggregate absolute top-5 retention bias must improve by at least 0.01 retention units versus P0.
step1_upper_tail.chronology: Across the six horizon x early/mid/validation cells, absolute top-5 retention bias must improve in at least five and may not worsen by more than 0.01 in any cell.
step1_upper_tail.top10_guardrail: Aggregate top-10 absolute retention bias may not worsen by more than 0.01 at either horizon.

step2_young_guardrail.young_top10_absolute_retention_bias: May not worsen by more than 0.01 at either horizon.
step2_young_guardrail.young_top10_conditional_mae: May not worsen by more than 1.0 fantasy point at either horizon.
step2_young_guardrail.developmental_unconditional_mae: May not worsen by more than 0.75 fantasy points at either horizon.

step3_broad_guardrails.overall_unconditional_mae: May not worsen by more than 0.50 fantasy points at either horizon.
step3_broad_guardrails.chronological_unconditional_mae: No early/mid/validation block may worsen by more than 1.0 point at either horizon.
step3_broad_guardrails.major_position_unconditional_mae: No QB/RB/WR/TE horizon aggregate may worsen by more than 1.0 point.
step3_broad_guardrails.overall_conditional_active_mae: May not worsen by more than 0.50 points at either horizon.

selection_rule.step4_meaningful_calibration_gain: Average reduction in absolute top-5 retention bias across Y2 and Y3 must be at least 0.01.
selection_rule.role_loss: Stress test only; report cost explicitly and do not use as a hindsight veto unless it triggers a broad guardrail already listed.
selection_rule.winner_if_multiple_pass: Choose the candidate with the lower sum of absolute Y2+Y3 top-5 retention bias. If candidates are within 0.005 total retention-bias units and within 0.25 points total Y2+Y3 unconditional MAE, prefer simpler P1.

serialization.prediction_rows: CSV with P0/P1/P2 conditional and unconditional predictions plus frozen probabilities/route and cohort flags.
serialization.fitted_candidate_package: Winning candidate only after historical freeze.

stop_rules: If P0 historical parity with durable control rows fails, stop Outcome C before comparing challengers.
If neither P1 nor P2 clears the predeclared selection rule, Outcome B and stop without final/current refit.
If a winner clears historical rules, freeze it before final fit and before a second current-board materialization.
No third challenger or route reopen.
